jobs.hint: Scheduled work: PM generation, SLA escalation, reminders, workflows and message delivery, plus delivery and workflow error checks. Platform admins are emailed when something is late or failing.

couponHint: Applied when you pay by card.

cancelManualBody: We'll confirm the cancellation. After that the Free plan's limits apply; nothing is deleted.
